behavior.name: camera_calibration
behavior.author: Gabriel Novas
behavior.description:
Intrinsic calibration of a camera with pictures of the ChArUco board (the board of charuco_calibrator/config/board.yaml).
1. Capture: move the board in front of the camera and press SPACE or ENTER for each picture (ESC cancels). The pictures of a previous capture are deleted first. 2. Calibration: the camera is calibrated with the pictures.
Everything is stored in ~/calibrations/CAMERA/intrinsic_calibrations/: - camera_calib_pictures/ (the pictures) - camera_intrinsics.yaml (the calibration in use: what the applications and the camera-robot calibration read; matrix, distortion, resolution, reprojection error and board) - camera_intrinsics_DATE.yaml (a copy of it, kept as history)

param.name: pic_num
param.label: Number of pictures
param.hint: Number of pictures to take (recommended: 20 to 30)

param.name: camera_type
param.label: Camera
param.hint: Camera to calibrate (a camera of charuco_calibrator/config/cameras.yaml)
